The number of clues possessed by the cult is equal to the total number of clues on [[Cultist]] enemies in play plus the number of clues on Clues Unveiled, below.

name: The Unsealing
text: Each non-weakness enemy gains: "Hunter. Prey - Investigator with The Twisted Antiprism." If The Twisted Antiprism is attached to that enemy, it instead gains "Patrol (Galata Docks)." Forced - When 1 or more doom would be placed on an enemy: It instead moves and attacks as if it were the enemy phase (without exhausting). Forced - After a non-weakness enemy attacks the investigator with The Twisted Antiprism: Attach The Twisted Antiprism to that enemy, [[Unstable]] side faceup. Then, that enemy shifts it. [reaction] After you evade or defeat the enemy with The Twisted Antiprism: Take control of The Twisted Antiprism, attaching it to your investigator.

name: Galata Docks
text: You can only enter Galata Docks from Galata. As an additional cost for you to do so, you must discard any combination of cards from your hand or assets from your play area with at least 3 matching skill icons.
backText: You can only enter Galata Docks from Galata. As an additional cost for you to do so, you must discard any combination of cards from your hand or assets from your play area with at least 3 matching skill icons.
flavor: With the Foundation's travel documents, you should be able to charter a ship out of the city with ease.

name: Galata
text: [fast] Spend 3 resources: Parley. Expose a concealed mini-card at any location. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Obelisk of Theodosius
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating the Obelisk of Theodosius: Move 1 of your clues to the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy.

name: Istanbul University
text: [action]: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (6). If you succeed, take control of 1 clue on Clues Unveiled. (Max one success per game.)

name: Hagia Sophia
text: Hagia Sophia gets +3 shroud for each study token on it. [action]: Place 1 [per_investigator] clues on Hagia Sophia (from the token pool). Place 1 resource on Hagia Sophia (also from the token pool), as a study token.

name: Grand Bazaar
text: Increase the difficulty to fight or evade each concealed mini-card at this location by 2.

name: Grand Bazaar
text: While you are at this location, treat the text box of each [[Weapon]] asset you control as if it were blank (except for [[Traits]]).

name: Grand Bazaar
text: [fast]: Parley. Take control of 1 clue from a [[Cultist]] enemy at this location. Then, return that enemy to the shadows and resolve its concealed keyword. (Limit once per round.)

name: Grand Bazaar
text: Forced - After you expose a decoy at this location: Move 1 clue from this location to the nearest [[Cultist]] enemy.

name: Grand Bazaar
text: Forced - When you would move out of this location: Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you must either lose 1 action or cancel the effects of the move.

name: Grand Bazaar
text: [reaction] After you move to this location from a connecting location: Test [agility] (4). If you succeed, move again. Forced - After an enemy moves to this location via hunter or patrol: Resolve that keyword again.

name: Grand Bazaar
text: [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, you may play a [[Charm]] or [[Relic]] asset from your hand, reducing its cost by 1 for each point you succeeded by (to a minimum of 0).

name: Ece Şahin
text: [fast] Exhaust Ece Şahin: Look at the top card of any investigator's deck. If it is not a weakness, you may place it facedown beneath Ece Sahin (limit 5 cards beneath her). Forced - After any key is shifted: The owner of each card beneath Ece Şahin draws that card.
flavor: "Why do you suppose the keys have not been erased?"

name: Umbral Harbinger
text: Hunter. Forced - When Umbral Harbinger is dealt damage: Place 1 doom on the [[Cultist]] enemy nearest to it.
flavor:
"Trouble with memory. I see things I never knew before. Other worlds and other galaxies... Dark... The lightning seems dark and the darkness seems light..."
- H. P. Lovecraft, "The Haunter of the Dark"

name: Sinister Aspirant (A)
text: Alert. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Sinister Aspirant is ready: Place 1 doom on it.
flavor:
I have seen the dark universe yawning
Where the black planets roll without aim...
- H. P. Lovecraft, "The Haunter of the Dark"

name: Sinister Aspirant (B)
text: Alert. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Sinister Aspirant is ready: Place 1 doom on it.
flavor:
I have seen the dark universe yawning
Where the black planets roll without aim...
- H. P. Lovecraft, "The Haunter of the Dark"

name: Sinister Aspirant (C)
text: Alert. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if Sinister Aspirant is ready: Place 1 doom on it.
flavor:
I have seen the dark universe yawning
Where the black planets roll without aim...
- H. P. Lovecraft, "The Haunter of the Dark"

name: Shadowed
text: Revelation - If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, take 1 horror and Shadowed gains surge. Otherwise, find the [[Cultist]] enemy nearest to you. Place 1 doom on that enemy and test [willpower] (X), where X is that enemy's fight value. If you fail, take 2 horror.

name: Accosted
text: Revelation - If there are no [[Cultist]] enemies in play, take 1 damage and Accosted gains surge. Otherwise, find the [[Cultist]] enemy nearest to you. Place 1 doom on that enemy and test [agility] (X), where X is that enemy's evade value. If you fail, take 2 damage.

name: Light Out of Void
text: Peril. Revelation - You must either (choose one): - Place 1 doom on the [[Cultist]] enemy in play with the highest evade. - Take 1 damage and 1 horror. If the investigators possess more clues than the cult, or if it is act 3, resolve this revelation ability a second time.

name: The Twisted Antiprism
text: Shift - Look at the top 3 cards of your deck. Draw 1 of those cards and shuffle the rest back into your deck. Flip this key to its [[Unstable]] side.
flavor: File #21-F30 / Subject Class: Red / Key is a trapezohedron-shaped crystal of unknown mineral, roughly 19 cm in length, impervious to both matter and light.

name: The Twisted Antiprism
text: Shift - The nearest investigator must place 1 doom on an asset they control, an encounter card at their location, or the current agenda. Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.
flavor: ...do not store in darkness under any circumstances.

name: Dancing Mad
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of enemies in the shadows (max 3).
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, put a decoy into play at your location, flip it over, and shuffle each concealed mini-card at your location facedown.
[tablet]: -3. If you fail, set each non-weakness card committed to this test aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[elder_thing]: -1. If there is a concealed mini-card at your location, either take 1 damage or treat this token's modifier as -3.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of enemies in the shadows (max 5).
[cultist]: -6. If you fail, put a decoy into play at your location, flip it over, and shuffle each concealed mini-card at your location facedown.
[tablet]: -3. Set each non-weakness card committed to this test aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[elder_thing]: -1. If there is a concealed mini-card at your location, either take 2 damage or treat this token's modifier as -5.

name: Silence Speaks
text: Forced - If there are 5 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 3 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.
backText: The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy with the concealed keyword and draw it (resolving its concealed keyword). Shuffle the encounter deck. - Reveal the top card of each investigator's deck. Each investigator draws each weakness they revealed in this way. Set each other revealed card aside, out of play, as a hollow.
flavor: A gentle patter of rain gives the moonless night a somber, moody ambience. Distant music and conversation drift on the wind, accompanied by a light drizzle.

name: Easy Prey
text: Forced - If there are 4 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 2 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.
backText: The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - Search the encounter deck and discard pile for an enemy with the concealed keyword and draw it (resolving its concealed keyword). Shuffle the encounter deck. - Reveal the top card of each investigator's deck. Each investigator draws each weakness they revealed in this way. Set each other revealed card aside, out of play, as a hollow.
flavor: Being hunted by the Coterie was bad enough; now you worry any random object you pass on the street, or even the sky itself, could simply swallow you whole, never to be seen or heard from again.

name: A Betrayal of Eyes
text: Forced - If there are 3 [per_investigator] or more set-aside hollows: Choose and remove 1 [per_investigator] of them from the game and place 1 doom on this agenda. This effect may cause this agenda to advance.
backText: Remove each hollow from the game. Gather each hollow that was removed from the game throughout this scenario. Each investigator finds their hollow with the highest experience cost and exiles it. In the Campaign Log, record erased from existence: and next to this, record the names of each unique card exiled in this way. For the rest of the campaign, players cannot include any copies of those cards (by title) in their decks (immediately remove any copies from each investigator's deck). (→R2) (page 31)
flavor: The city is alive. Not alive in its usual sense - music and revelry and glamor - but truly, disturbingly alive. The streets shift under your feet, walls undulating as though breathing, windows glaring at you from afar. Sweat beads on your forehead. Is this all real? Or just paranoia?

name: False Step (v. I)
text: [action]: Resign. "The deal's off!" You leave Desi and his crew to their fate. Forced - If Desiderio Delgado Álvarez leaves play: Set him aside, out of play. Each investigator takes 1 horror.
backText: If the Desiderio Delgado Álvarez story asset is in play, set him aside, out of play (removing all tokens and attachments from him). Find the set-aside Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy with the encounter card back. The lead investigator draws that enemy, resolving his concealed keyword. One at a time, in player order, each other investigator chooses a different set-aside [[Coterie]] enemy and draws it, resolving its concealed keyword. Shuffle the encounter discard pile and the remainder of the Crimson Conspiracy and Cleanup Crew encounter sets into the encounter deck.
flavor: You and Desi are looking into the disappearances taking place in Havana. It has to be the work of the creatures you were investigating back in London. But they haven't been forgotten yet - maybe there is a way to bring them back?

name: False Colors (v. I)
text: [reaction] When an investigator would resolve an enemy's concealed X keyword, spend X clues, as a group: Spawn it engaged with that investigator instead. [action]: Resign. You leave Desi and his crew to their fate. Objective - If there are no enemies in the shadows, investigators may spend the requisite clues to advance.
backText: Ready the Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy, remove all tokens from him, and discard all attachments from him. Find the previously set-aside Desiderio Delgado Álvarez story asset, flip him to his enemy side, and spawn him at the same location as the one in play, randomizing them so you do not know which is which.
flavor: Wait - what in the world just happened? That entity touched Desi and assumed his form. Is that what has been happening to Desi's crew? You have to find him before it finishes the job!

name: False Step (v. II)
text: Forced - At the end of the enemy phase: Deal X total damage to investigators at Café Luna, divided as they wish. X is the number of enemies in the shadows. [reaction] After a [[Coterie]] enemy takes any amount of damage: Discover half that many clues at Café Luna (rounded down).
backText:
Shuffle the encounter discard pile and each set-aside [[Outsider]] enemy into the encounter deck.
If Desiderio Delgado Álvarez is not in the shadows, return him to the shadows and resolve his concealed keyword.
Put each set-aside [[Havana]] location into play.
Take each concealed mini-card in play, shuffle them, and randomly distribute them as evenly as possible among each location other than Café Luna.
flavor: Negotiations didn't go so well after all.

name: False Colors (v. II)
text: [action] As a group, investigators at your location place clues they control on a [[Coterie]] enemy at your location equal to that enemy's remaining health: Parley. You gain some insight into the situation. Remove all doom from that enemy and automatically evade it. [action]: Resign. "I thought we had a deal!" You get out of the city while you still can. Objective - Discover why your contacts are after you. If there are 4 [per_investigator] total clues among enemies in play, advance.
backText:
Reveal each concealed mini-card in play. For each enemy's mini-card, move that enemy from the shadows to that location. Then, set each concealed mini-card aside, out of play.
Ready the Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy, remove all tokens from him, and discard all attachments from him. Spawn the other set-aside Desiderio Delgado Álvarez enemy at the same location as the one in play, randomizing them so you do not know which is which.
Remove all clues from each enemy in play. For each clue removed from an enemy in this way, heal 1 damage from that enemy.
flavor: Desi and his crew are pursuing and attacking you everywhere you go! But why?

name: False Light
text: Each copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez loses concealed X, loses hunter, gains aloof, and gains the following ability: "[action]: Parley. Check the Campaign Log. If the cell knows Desi's past, you ask a question only he can answer. Look at the other side of this enemy." Objective - If either copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez is defeated, advance. (Do not look at its other side.)
backText: For the remainder of the campaign, do not look at the other sides of either copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez until you are instructed to do so. Find the copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez that is in play (if both copies are in the victory display, return one to play). Store this copy of Desiderio Delgado Álvarez in a safe place where you may refer to it later in the campaign. (→R1) (page 31)
flavor: You arrive just in time to see two exact replicas of Desiderio embroiled in a deadly battle for the fate of his identity. In the midst of this chaos, it's impossible to tell which is which. There is no time to study their mannerisms. You have to act!

name: Café Luna
flavor: Desi's bar offers a variety of drinks and a rich, wild nightlife for both locals and tourists from the States looking to escape the tight grip of Prohibition... or, at least, it used to, before he and his guns shot the place to hell. What in the world is going on here?

name: Café Luna
text: Café Luna gets -1 shroud for each [[Outsider]] enemy in play. Forced - If there are no clues on Café Luna: Add clues to it until it has 1 [per_investigator] clues on it.
flavor: Desi's bar offers a variety of drinks and a rich, wild nightlife for both locals and tourists from the States looking to escape the tight grip of Prohibition.

name: El Malecón
text: [reaction] After you expose a decoy at El Malecón: Expose another concealed mini-card at El Malecón. (Group limit once per round.)
flavor: A patter of drizzling rain sets a somber mood as you scour the Malecón for any trace of Desi's crew.

name: Jardines de la Tropical
text: [reaction] After you successfully investigate Jardines de la Tropical by 3 or more: Choose a set-aside hollow. Its owner draws it. Forced - After you fail by 3 or more while investigating Jardines de la Tropical: Choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.

name: Gran Teatro de La Habana
text: [fast] During your turn, spend 2 resources: Reduce Gran Teatro de La Habana's shroud by 2 until the end of your turn. (Limit once per turn.)

name: Miramar Yacht Club
text: [action]: Investigate. Instead of discovering clues, look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at Miramar Yacht Club. For every 2 points you succeed by, look at the revealed side of an additional concealed mini-card at Miramar Yacht Club.
flavor: Desi's crew sure know how to live it up.

name: Plaza Hotel
text: [fast] Take 1 horror: Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card at Plaza Hotel or at a connecting location (without exposing it). (Group limit once per round.)

name: Desiderio Delgado Álvarez
text: Alert. Concealed 1 [per_investigator]. Hunter. Retaliate. Desiderio Delgado Álvarez gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When Desiderio Delgado Álvarez takes damage during act 1 or 2: Instead, automatically evade him. [reaction] After Desiderio Delgado Álvarez is evaded by 2 or more and there is another copy of him at your location, that copy deals this one 2 damage.
subname: The Man in the Blood-Soaked Suit

name: Desiderio Delgado Álvarez
text: Alert. Concealed 1 [per_investigator]. Hunter. Retaliate. Desiderio Delgado Álvarez gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When Desiderio Delgado Álvarez takes damage during act 1 or 2: Instead, automatically evade him. [reaction] After Desiderio Delgado Álvarez is evaded by 2 or more and there is another copy of him at your location, that copy deals this one 2 damage.
subname: The Man in the Blood-Soaked Suit

name: Desiderio Delgado Álvarez
text: [reaction] When an attack from a [[Monster]] enemy deals damage to Desiderio Delgado Álvarez, exhaust him: Cancel 1 of that damage and deal 1 damage to the attacking enemy.
subname: In Your Debt, Despite it All

name: Body Snatched
text: Revelation - Test [willpower] (4). If you fail, choose an [[Ally]] or [[Item]] asset you control and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow (if you cannot, take 2 horror instead).
flavor: A false facsimile? Or a paradimensional plot?

name: On Thin Ice
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the number of [[Hazard]] treacheries in play.
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[tablet]: -2 (-5 instead if Void Chimera is at your location).
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the number of [[Hazard]] treacheries in play.
[cultist]: -5. Choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
[tablet]: -3. If Void Chimera is at your location, you automatically fail, instead.
[elder_thing]: -4. Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow.

name: Lost and Forgotten
backText: Each investigator chooses an [[Ally]] or [[Item]] asset in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
flavor: The prospector's journal described a horrifying predator. Some call the thing stalking the woods a beast, some call it a spirit, and others know it as a shapeshifter. Describing the thing seems to fill each witness with a primal, unspeakable terror.

name: Eyes of the Void
backText: Each investigator chooses an [[Ally]] or [[Item]] asset in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
flavor: As you explore the region, you cannot shake the feeling that you are being watched. It as though a thousand eyes are staring directly at you... or perhaps through you. The surrounding forest is filled with a deafening silence.

name: Annihilation
backText: Remove each hollow from the game. Gather each hollow that was removed from the game throughout this scenario. Each investigator finds their hollow with the highest experience cost and exiles it. In the Campaign Log, record erased from existence: and next to this, record the names of each unique card exiled in this way. For the rest of the campaign, players cannot include any copies of those cards (by title) in their decks (immediately remove any copies from each investigator's deck). (→R4) (page 35)
flavor: The landscape around you is being actively devoured, stolen from existence and memory. A feeling of numbness spreads through you as you stare at the fading wilderness. An uncanny sense that you are losing your grip on reality nags at the edge of your mind.

name: Quest for the Sable Glass
text: Objective - Only investigators at the Condemned Gold Mine may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
backText:
If it is agenda 1:
Ignoring signs warning that the mine is condemned and dangerous, you trace a path to the branch Landry wrote about in his journal and find the Sable Glass buried in the rock. When you emerge, however, you are not alone.
If it is agenda 2 or 3:
As you approach the condemned mine, you see from the broken barricades and tracks in the snow that Thorne and the Coterie have already arrived. Before you can backtrack, two guards emerge from the shadows brandishing shotguns. "Don't move," one of them says.
In either case: Read Scenario Interlude: Raw Deal in the Campaign Guide.
flavor: Thorne may have a head start in their search for the Sable Glass, but you have something they don't: Rhett Landry's journal. If you can reach the prospector's gold mine before the Coterie, you may be able to keep the Key out of their hands.

name: If It Bleeds...
text: [action] If your location has the [[Wilderness]] trait and investigators at your location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Place 1 resource on your location, as a scouting report. (Limit 1 scouting report per [[Wilderness]] location.) Objective - You may advance at the end of any round. (Hint: You will lure out the predator when you advance. Advance when you believe you are prepared.)
backText: Spawn Void Chimera (True Form) in the shadows and resolve its concealed keyword, distributing each of those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each [[Wilderness]] location in play. For each location with a scouting report on it, you may look at the revealed side of the concealed mini-card just placed at that location.
flavor: Thorne said they were trying to track the predator in these woods. Although the beast leaves no trace, you can surely scout the surrounding area before luring it out.

name: Prowling Nightmare
text: Objective - After Void Chimera (True Form) is exposed, advance the act.
flavor: The shifting, chimeric form of the paradimensional beast flits in and out of view. It is playing games with you, much like a cat plays with a mouse. If you can expose its true form, perhaps you can turn the game on its head and banish it once and for all.

name: Outsiders' Lair
text: Revelation - Put Outsiders' Lair into play and move Void Chimera (True Form) and each investigator at its location to Outsiders' Lair. While Outsiders' Lair has no clues on it, Void Chimera (True Form) gets -1 fight and -1 evade.

name: Last Stand
text: The location where Void Chimera (True Form) was exposed is connected to Outsiders' Lair (but not vice versa.) Objective - If Void Chimera (True Form) is defeated, advance the act.
backText: Check which version of Thorne is in play: - If the Thorne story asset is in play, (→R1) (page 35). - If the Thorne enemy is in play, (→R2) (page 35). - If Thorne is not in play, (→R3) (page 35).
flavor: Your prey has trapped you in its own lair. The alien beast unveils itself in all its otherworldly grandeur, looming over you in myriad, amorphous forms.

name: Anchorage
text: [action]: Choose a set-aside hollow. Its owner draws it. (Limit once per round.) [action]: Resign. "I thought Alaska was supposed to be nice this time of year!"

name: Fairbanks
text: [reaction] When an investigator at Fairbanks draws a [[Hazard]] treachery: Spend 2 resources to cancel that treachery's effects and discard it.
flavor:
All around me I sensed a queer coldness in the demeanor of my neighbors, my friends.
 - Virgil Gray, "In the Court of the Outsiders"

name: Mountain Stream
text: Forced - After you enter Mountain Stream: Test [intellect] or [agility] (1). If you fail, take 1 damage. Forced - After the last clue is discovered from Mountain Stream: Put the 3 set-aside Outer Wilderness locations into play adjacent to it.
flavor: Crossing the cracking ice is incredibly dangerous, but you have little other choice.

name: Frozen Lake
text: Forced - After an investigator at this location reveals a [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbol during a skill test they are performing: They must either choose and discard 1 card from their hand, or take 1 horror.

name: Isolated Road
text: The first [[Hazard]] treachery revealed by an investigator at this location each round gains surge.
flavor: The silence of the vast listening forest stole forward and enveloped them. - Algernon Blackwood, The Wendigo

name: Forgotten Outpost
text: [action]: Draw 3 cards. (Limit once per game.)
flavor: While hardly large enough to qualify as a town, this small settlement feels like a bastion of comfort after days on end of trying wilderness.

name: Hunter's Lodge
text: Forced - When you reveal Hunter's Lodge: Test [willpower] or [intellect] (3) to talk the hunter down. If you fail, take 1 damage. Forced - When a [[Monster]] enemy enters this location: Deal 1 damage to it.
flavor: And here you thought the Outsiders were the dangerous ones.

name: Condemned Gold Mine
text: [action]: Reveal 1 random chaos token from the chaos bag plus 1 additional token for each depletion token on Condemned Gold Mine. If you did not reveal any [skull], [cultist], [tablet], or [elder_thing] symbols in this way, gain 4 resources and place 1 resource (from the token pool) on Condemned Gold Mine, as a depletion token.

name: Thorne
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Thorne gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After a [[Hazard]] treachery is drawn: Thorne shifts each of their attached keys. Forced - When Thorne is defeated: If The Sable Glass is attached to Thorne, attach it to any investigator, under that investigator's control.
subname: The One with the Red Cravat

name: Thorne
text: [reaction] After an investigator at your location sets a card aside as a hollow, exhaust Thorne: That investigator may take an immediate action as if it were their turn.
flavor: "Just admit it. I'm better at this than you."

name: Void Chimera
text: Concealed 4. Massive. You cannot expose any concealed mini-cards while one of Void Chimera's other forms is in play. Forced - After you expose one of Void Chimera's decoys: Find the set-aside version of Void Chimera with the matching subtitle and spawn it at your location.

name: Void Chimera
text: Patrol ([[Wilderness]] location with the most investigators). Retaliate. Void Chimera (Fellbeak) gets +1 [per_investigator] health.
flavor: The beast's exquisite plumage is quite literally stunning.

name: Void Chimera
text: Alert. Hunter. Void Chimera (Earsplitter) gets +1 [per_investigator] health.
flavor: The beast's carapace rattles with an unsettling hiss. While much of the sound lies beyond the scope of your hearing, its eerie resonance shakes you to your core.

name: Void Chimera
text: Hunter. Void Chimera (Gorefeaster) gets +1 [per_investigator] health. Forced - After Void Chimera (Gorefeaster) attacks you: Look at the top card of your deck. If it is not a weakness, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow, and heal damage from Void Chimera (Gorefeaster) equal to that hollow's printed cost.

name: Void Chimera
text: Hunter. Void Chimera (Fellhound) gets +1 [per_investigator] health. While you are attacking or attempting to evade Void Chimera (Fellhound), if you own any set-aside hollows, it gains alert and retaliate.

name: Ravenous Grizzly
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Spawn - Nearest [[Wilderness]] location. Ravenous Grizzly cannot enter non-[[Wilderness]] locations. While Ravenous Grizzly is moving, it skips over connecting non-[[Wilderness]] locations.

name: Cracking Ice
text: Revelation - Put Cracking Ice into play next to the agenda deck. Then, if there are 3 or more copies of Cracking Ice next to the agenda deck, discard them all and each investigator at a [[Wilderness]] location tests [agility] (4). Each investigator who fails must take 1 damage, take 1 horror, or lose 1 action for each point they failed by.

name: Snowslide
text: Revelation - Test [agility] (3). If you fail, you and each asset with health you control takes 1 direct damage.
flavor: If you hear that soft roar approaching, it's already too late.

name: The Sable Glass
text: Shift - Look at the revealed side of each concealed mini-card at your location (without exposing them). Flip this key to its [[Unstable]] side.
flavor: File #33-K31 / Subject Class: Green / Subject is a warped lens of indeterminate translucent material. Layer appears as window to other layers when viewed through lens.

name: The Sable Glass
text: Shift - Each investigator sets the non-weakness card in their hand with the highest printed cost aside, out of play, as a hollow. Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.
flavor: ...beware of prolonged exposure to paradimensional viewpoint / other side can see you, too...

name: Dogs of War
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -1 (-3 instead if you are at a location with a Key Locus).
[cultist]: -3. If you fail, either take 1 damage and 1 horror, or place 1 doom on the nearest Key Locus or [[Locus Site]] location.
[tablet]: -2. If this is an attack against an enemy with patrol, after this attack, it disengages and resolves its patrol keyword.
[elder_thing]: -2. For each point you fail by, lose 1 resource (max 3).
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -2 (-4 instead if you are at a location with a Key Locus).
[cultist]: -5. If you fail, either take 1 damage and 1 horror, or place 1 doom on the nearest Key Locus or [[Locus Site]] location.
[tablet]: -2. If this is an attack against an enemy with patrol, after this attack, it attacks you, disengages, and resolves its patrol keyword.
[elder_thing]: -3. For each point you fail by, lose 1 resource.

name: Brewing Catastrophe (v. I)
text: Each enemy loses hunter and gains patrol (nearest location with a Key Locus). While there are no other Key Locuses in play, The Claret Knight counts as a Key Locus for the purposes of card abilities. When checking the doom threshold, doom on cards other than this agenda subtract from the total doom in play instead of adding to it. Objective - Defend the Knight! If The Claret Knight is defeated, advance this agenda.
backText:
If this agenda advanced by reaching its doom threshold:
The storm rages on. Doors batter and foundations shake. The Key Locuses dim. You've stood your ground for as long as you can. Weary and terrified that you have chosen an impossible course, you and your unlikely Coterie allies retreat to the Claret Knight's office as a last line of defense. The mood is tense and quiet. Any moment you suspect the Beast or its devotees will tear down the door and turn this chamber into a bloodbath...
Advance the act.
If The Claret Knight was defeated:
The storm rages on. Doors batter and foundations shake. The Key Locuses have failed. You've stood your ground for as long as you could. Weary and terrified that you have chosen an impossible course, you are forced to lay low for a moment to lick your wounds. That is when the Beast strikes...
(→R3) (page 42)
flavor: The Beast is coming to claim its due...

name: Brewing Catastrophe (v. II)
text: While there are no other Key Locuses in play, The Bourse counts as a Key Locus for the purposes of card abilities.
backText:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
- Each surviving investigator immediately takes 1 direct damage and suffers 1 physical trauma. Flip this agenda back over and place 10 doom on it.
- Each surviving investigator immediately resigns.
flavor: You've refused the offer of the Coterie agent who appears to control things in Alexandria, and instead teamed up with a local Foundation operative, Hossam Sirry, who hopes to see the Coterie ousted from the city. With any luck, you can claim the Key here for yourself as well, killing two birds with one stone.

name: Brewing Catastrophe (v. III)
text: While there are no other Key Locuses in play, Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa counts as a Key Locus for the purposes of card abilities.
backText:
The investigators must decide (choose one):
- Each surviving investigator immediately takes 1 direct damage and suffers 1 physical trauma. Flip this agenda back over and place 10 doom on it.
- Each surviving investigator immediately resigns.
flavor: In your pursuit of Alexandria's Key, you are on the trail of the Beast in a Cowl of Crimson, a Coterie member so dangerous and chaotic, even the rest of the Coterie fears its wrath. Its bloody rampage has sent the entire city into a state of terror.

name: Rabbits Who Run (v. I)
text: During the "enemies attack" step of the enemy phase, in addition to their standard attacks, each ready enemy attacks each Key Locus at its location as if it were an engaged investigator. Horror dealt by these attacks is dealt as damage, instead. Objective - Defend the Key and hold out for as long as you can. (The agenda represents how long you must defend it. You will be instructed when to advance.)
backText: Add The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson to the victory display. Add each Key Locus in play to the victory display. (→R1) (page 42)
flavor: You've agreed to help The Claret Knight and his enforcers defend his Key from another member of the Coterie - the Beast in a Cowl of Crimson.

name: Rabbits Who Run (v. II)
text: Objective - If The Claret Knight is defeated, or if an investigator controls The Light of Pharos, advance.
backText:
If the investigators took control of the Light of Pharos:
You safely enter the office where you met with the Coterie earlier and crack open the vault. The light inside shines on undisturbed. You snatch the Key from its resting place and abscond before the rest of the knight's enforcers catch up to you.
(→R2) (page 42) If the investigators defeated The Claret Knight:
"Fools," the knight utters, clutching his side. "Do you not understand? We are the last guardians of humanity. Without us..." Cutting him off, several of his bodyguards suddenly rush into the chamber, but they are too late to stop you. Rather than confront you, they pull their leader to safety. "You will pay for this," the elderly man shouts through a barrage of coughs as he is escorted off the premises. "We will all pay for this."
(→R2) (page 42)
flavor:
"The Bourse is their base of operations," Agent Sirry summarizes what you know before you put your plan into action. "If we're going to confront the Coterie, we have to first destroy the Key Locuses scattered around the city. Otherwise, we don't stand a chance."
You nod, recalling what the Claret Knight told you earlier. If you can find and destroy these locuses, you can enter The Bourse once more.

name: Rabbits Who Run (v. III)
text: Objective - If The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson is defeated, or if an investigator controls The Light of Pharos, advance.
backText:
If the investigators took control of the Light of Pharos:
You sneak carefully through the catacombs, searching for the place where the Beast has hidden the Light of Pharos. Eventually, you find a hidden passage leading to a tomb much deeper beneath the city. Inside, a telltale glow emanates from the cracks of an ancient sarcophagus. You push off the stone lid and claim the Key from within, fleeing before the Beast realizes what you have done.
If the investigators defeated the Beast in a Cowl of Crimson:
The Beast lets out a sinister growl and retreats, leaving a trail of ichorous blood in its wake. You could pursue it, but your prize lies deeper in the catacombs, and besides, you worry how dangerous such a creature might become when cornered...
In either case: Check the Campaign Log: - If the cell made a deal with the Claret Knight, (→R5) (page 43) - If the cell is assisting Agent Sirry, (→R6) (page 43)
flavor: Somewhere in the city, the Beast dwells in its lair, sending its devotees to the streets to spill blood and kidnap victims to feast upon. If you are to stop this bloodbath, you'll have to first destroy the Key Locuses scattered around the city which protect the Beast's lair. Only then can you retrieve the Key it has stolen and drive the Beast from Alexandria.

name: The Bourse
text:
Unless The Claret Knight is the only Key Locus in play, enemies cannot enter The Bourse (if an enemy would spawn here, spawn it at a connecting location instead).
[action] Investigators at The Bourse spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remove 1 doom from any location or from an asset you control. Any player may trigger this ability.
backText: The entrance to the offices is secure. Unless The Claret Knight is the only Key Locus in play, enemies cannot enter The Bourse (if an enemy would spawn here, spawn it at a connecting location instead).

name: The Bourse
text: [action]: Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to place 1 resource on the Light of Pharos. Then, if there are 3 resources on the Light of Pharos, choose an investigator at this location to take control of it.
backText: The entrance to the offices is guarded. You cannot enter The Bourse unless it is the only Key Locus in play.

name: The Bourse
text: [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, gain 4 resources. You may reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. If you do, gain 2 fewer resources if you succeed. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Windsor Palace Hotel
text:
While you are at Windsor Palace Hotel...
- ...if there is a Key Locus here, increase the cost of each [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you play by 1.
- ...if there is no Key Locus here, reduce the cost of each [[Item]] or [[Ally]] asset you play by 1.

name: Victoria College
text: [reaction] When you would draw exactly 1 card from your deck while you are at Victoria College: Instead, look at the top 2 cards of your deck, choose 1 to draw, and shuffle the other back into your deck. (Limit once per round.)

name: Qaitbay Citadel
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while investigating Qaitbay Citadel: You cannot discover clues or expose concealed mini-cards at Qaitbay Citadel for the remainder of the round.

name: The Corniche
text: Forced - After The Corniche is successfully investigated: Increase the difficulty of each other test performed at The Corniche this round by 2.

name: Zan'et el Settat
text: Forced - When you fight an enemy while at Zan'et el Settat: You must either spend 1 action or increase that enemy's fight by 2 for this attack.

name: Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa
text: [action]: Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, investigators at this location may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to place 1 resource on the Light of Pharos. Then, if there are 3 resources on the Light of Pharos, choose an investigator at this location to take control of it.
backText: The way into the catacombs is hidden. You cannot enter the Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa unless it is the only Key Locus in play.

name: Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa
text: [action]: Test [willpower] (6). If you succeed, automatically evade The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson (regardless of its current location). (Group limit once per game.)
backText: The way into the catacombs is blocked. You cannot enter the Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa. The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson cannot leave Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa. Forced - If there is 6 or more doom on the current agenda: Reveal Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa.
flavor: The interior of the necropolis is covered in scorch marks and lined with streaks of dried blood. What in the hell happened here...?

name: Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa
text: [action]: Investigate. If you succeed, instead of discovering clues, draw 3 cards. You may reduce the difficulty of this test by 2. If you do, draw 1 fewer card if you succeed. (Group limit once per round.)

name: Key Locus
text: You may attack Key Locus as if it were an enemy with 4 fight. [action] Spend 1 clue: Deal 2 damage to Key Locus. Forced - If Key Locus is defeated: Add it to the victory display.

name: Key Locus
text: [action] Spend 1 clue: Test [willpower] (2). Heal 1 damage from Key Locus, plus 1 additional damage for each point you succeed by. Forced - If Key Locus is defeated: Remove it from the game (do not add it to the victory display).

name: The Claret Knight
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while at The Claret Knight's location, if he is ready: He shifts each of his attached keys.
flavor: "I do not involve myself in the matters of mice."

name: The Claret Knight
text:
[fast] Exhaust The Claret Knight: Move up to 3 resources from your resource pool to The Claret Knight.
[fast] Exhaust The Claret Knight: Move up to 3 resources from The Claret Knight to your resource pool, or to an asset you control as charges, ammo, supplies, or secrets.
flavor: "I will serve, until such time as I am no longer needed."

name: The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson
text: Patrol (nearest location with a Key Locus). Retaliate. Forced - When The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson would be defeated: Instead, heal all damage from it, exhaust it, and move it to Catacombs of Kom el Shoqafa, unengaged.

name: The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson
text: Forced - After you fail a skill test while at The Beast in a Cowl of Crimson's location, if it is ready: It shifts each of its attached keys.
flavor: The thing in the cowl growls, its voice low and gutteral. Is it even human?

name: Scarlet Beast
text:
Alert. Hunter. Retaliate.
Scarlet Beast gets +2 fight and -2 evade while it is at a [[Locus Site]] location.
flavor: A creature of crimson, fueled by blood and instinct. It snarls and eyes you as one might a delicious meal.

name: Coterie Provocateur
text: Aloof. Patrol (nearest location with a Key Locus). Spawn - Nearest location with a Key Locus. While Coterie Provocateur is ready, investigators at its location cannot attack anything with a title other than Coterie Provocateur.
spawn: Nearest location with a Key Locus

name: Locus Pulse
text: Revelation - Attach Locus Pulse to the nearest location with a Key Locus. Each investigator at that location takes 1 damage and 1 horror. Forced - If there is no Key Locus at attached location: Discard Locus Pulse.

name: The Light of Pharos
text: Shift - Play a card from your hand, at -3 cost. Flip this key to its [[Unstable]] side.
flavor: File #38-N31 / Subject Class: Yellow / Subject is a crystalline container filled with rippling liquid of unknown origin. Key emits sapphire light and is warm to the touch.

name: The Light of Pharos
text: Shift - Each investigator must discard 2 random non-weakness cards from their hand. Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.
flavor: ...liquid cannot be allowed to leak from container. In event of catastrophic containment failure, alert Foundation operatives at once.

name: Shades of Suffering
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of charges on The Shade Reaper, rounded up (X cannot be greater than 6).
[cultist]: -4. If you fail by 2 or more, place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper.
[tablet]: -1. If you are at a location with a [[Geist]] enemy, reveal an additional chaos token.
[elder_thing]: -4. You may place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper to treat this token's modifier as 0 instead.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of charges on The Shade Reaper.
[cultist]: -5. Place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper.
[tablet]: -3. If you are at a location with a [[Geist]] enemy, you automatically fail.
[elder_thing]: -6. You may place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper to treat this token's modifier as -3 instead.

name: Painful History
backText: Each investigator loses all of their clues. The lead investigator must decide (choose one): - Discard the [[Ally]] asset in play with the highest printed cost. Test [willpower] (X), where X is that asset's printed cost. If you fail, place charges on The Shade Reaper equal to the discarded asset's printed cost. - Place 1 doom on Tzu San Niang. If it is act 1, advance the act (to act 1b).
flavor: The city buzzes with spiritual activity. Empty halls resound with footsteps, phantom knocks, voiceless whispers. Some deep pain in this city longs to be known. A wordless dread fills the silence and pervades every moment.

name: Restless Dead
text: If there is only one investigator in the game, this agenda gets +1 doom threshold. Forced - When you engage Tzu San Niang: Investigators at your location must spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group. If they cannot, draw the top card of the encounter deck instead. (Hint: When this agenda advances, Tzu San Niang will harvest a nearby spirit if her location is unknown!)
backText:
If Tzu San Niang is in play at any location: Tzu San Niang attacks each investigator at her location. Return her to the shadows and resolve her concealed keyword, distributing each of those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each location with a non-weakness [[Geist]] enemy. Flip this card back to agenda 2a.
If Tzu San Niang is in the shadows: Reveal all concealed mini-cards in play and set each decoy aside, out of play. Swap the Tzu San Niang enemy with her concealed mini-card. Place each non-weakness [[Geist]] enemy at her location facedown beneath her, then place 4 charges on The Shade Reaper. If there are no non-weakness [[Geist]] enemies in play, advance the act to act 2b. Otherwise, return Tzu San Niang to the shadows and resolve her concealed keyword, distributing each of those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each location with a non-weakness [[Geist]] enemy. Flip this card back to agenda 2a.
flavor: The sense that you are not alone grows, and the spirits' wordless screams fill your mind. An oily fog rolls in to choke the streets of Kuala Lumpur in a ghostly aura.

name: Fear The Reaper
text: Each [[Geist]] enemy gain hunter and retaliate and cannot be flipped over. Forced - When doom is placed on this agenda: Remove 1 [[Geist]] enemy from beneath Tzu San Niang and spawn it faceup at her location.
backText: Each investigator is defeated and suffers 1 mental trauma. (→R3)
flavor: Tzu San Niang smiles sweetly as she bears down on you. Behind her, a massive shadow moves of its own accord, writhing in fulminant patterns on the wall. "This will be quick," she coos.

name: The Lady with the Red Parasol
text: Objective - Find Tzu San Niang before the agenda advances. When you engage Tzu San Niang, investigators must spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance. If they cannot, return her to the shadows and resolve her concealed keyword.
backText: Put the set-aside Melati's Shop location into play and reveal it. Disengage each investigator from each enemy engaged with them and move each investigator to Melati's Shop. Read Scenario Interlude: The Bomoh (page 47).
flavor: The figure holding a red parasol melts into the bustle of the city, but is she aware of your presence? If you can track her to her destination, you may better understand her aims in Kuala Lumpur.

name: Ghost Light
text: [[Geist]] enemies cannot leave [[Haunted]] locations. Objective - Quell the restless spirits before they are consumed by Tzu San Niang! At the end of the round, if there are no non-weakness [[Geist]] enemies in play, advance.
backText:
If there are no enemies facedown beneath Tzu San Niang:
A petite figure emerges from the yellow haze. Tzu San Niang points at you accusingly. "How dare you! You have no right to interfere with my work," she seethes. The parasol in her hand glows with strange energy.
Reveal all concealed mini-cards and remove them from the game. Flip Tzu San Niang to her (Out for Blood) side and spawn her at the location where her mini-card was. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).
If there is at least 1 enemy facedown beneath Tzu San Niang:
A petite figure emerges from the yellow haze. Tzu San Niang smirks as she twirls her parasol overhead. "What is it? You're still thirsty?" she coos, speaking to something you can't see. "They're ready to harvest." The parasol in her hand glows with strange energy.
The lead investigator exposes all concealed mini-cards. Flip Tzu San Niang to her (Out for Blood) side and heal all damage from her. She engages the lead investigator. Advance the agenda directly to agenda 3a (do not resolve agenda 2b).
flavor: Melati spoke of the great suffering Tzu San Niang has brought to this city. Perhaps by entreating the spirits and laying them to rest, you can stop her from reaping the pain she has sown.

name: Harvester of Woe
text: [reaction] When you are dealt damage and/or horror from Tzu San Niang's forced effect, investigators at your location may spend any number of clues: Cancel that much damage/horror. Objective - If Tzu San Niang is defeated, advance.
backText: The investigators must decide (choose one): - Use the parasol against her. (→R1) - Let her go. (→R2)
flavor: The Lady with the Red Parasol has shifted her attention to you. She sings a haunting song as she stalks through the streets. Under any other circumstance, you might find the melody beautiful.

name: Kuala Lumpur Station
text: [fast] During your turn, pay 2 resources: Move (to a connecting location). (Limit once per turn.) [action] Discard an asset you control from play: Gain resources equal to half the discarded asset's printed cost, rounded down, and remember that you "traded for a kitten." (Group limit once per game.)

name: Kuala Lumpur Station
text: [action]: Resign. "There's nothing more we can do here." You hastily book passage out of the city. [action] Investigators at this location spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Heal 2 horror. Remember that you "found a cheap memento."

name: Selangor Club
text: Each investigator at Selangor Club does not collect resources during the upkeep phase. [action] Spend 2 resources: Parley. You enjoy a pleasant meal and drinks. Heal 1 damage and 1 horror from an investigator or [[Ally]] asset at your location. (Limit once per round.)

name: Selangor Club Padang
text: [action]: Parley. Test [combat] (4) to join the games. If you fail, remember that you "embarrassed the consulate." If you succeed, gain 3 resources. (Max one success per round.)
flavor: The tight-lipped expatriates become much more trusting once you help their team achieve victory.

name: Melati's Shop
text: [action] Investigators at Melati's Shop spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Remember that you "peered beyond." Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card or the other side of a [[Geist]] enemy in play.
flavor: "When I quiet my mind, I can hear them clearly."

name: Wayang Kulit Theater
text:
X is equal to half the charges on The Shade Reaper, rounded up (to a max of 8).
[action] Investigators at Wayang Kulit Theater spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group: Heal 2 damage. Remember that you "shared a deep pain."

name: Tin Mine
text: [action]: Test [agility] (6). Investigators at Tin Mine may spend 1 [per_investigator] clues, as a group, to automatically succeed. If you succeed, draw 2 cards and remember that you "found hidden bones." (Group limit once per game.) Forced - After you fail a skill test while at Tin Mine: Take 1 damage.

name: Uncanny Shadow
text: Uncanny Shadow gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action] Discard 1-3 cards from your hand at random: Parley. Test [willpower] (6). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each card you discarded as part of this action's cost. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When Uncanny Shadow would be defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Playful Shadows
text:
If an investigator has "embarrassed the consulate," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
The sound of laughter turns to weeping, then turns back to laughter. "It is the spirit of a boy," Melati tells you. A round ball rolls out from the darkness to your feet as you look up at the trembling forms. "The padang where he once played is now the ground of one of Ms. Tzu's endeavors. Your small gesture amused him. I think he will be at peace now."
Add this card to the victory display.
flavor: The theater fills with the sound of chittering laughter as wavering shapes dance against a papery backdrop. Melati chuckles as she looks at you. "No need to worry," she says. "This spirit is restless, but it does not bear us ill will." Looking up at the papery shadows, she intones a low chant in Malay.

name: Uncanny Shadow
text: Uncanny Shadow gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action] Discard 1-3 cards from your hand at random: Parley. Test [willpower] (6). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each card you discarded as part of this action's cost. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When Uncanny Shadow would be defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Timorous Shadows
text:
If an investigator has "peered beyond," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
"It is the spirit of a girl. She watched many stories unfold in this very theater," says Melati. The shadow on the screen forms a hungry smile filled with sharp teeth that turns to a fearful frown. "She is loathe to let go of this place, for she does not know if her story will continue." As Melati translates, you assure the spirit that you have looked beyond the veil and she can leave this plane of existence. As the hoary shadows dissipate, you feel a coldness as you reflect on what you saw - and didn't see - in the beyond. Was it wrong to reassure her?
Add this card to the victory display.
flavor: The theater fills with cacophonous laughter as a spindly shape on the paper screen grows menacing. Melati strides forward, her voice firm. "I know that you are restless," she says. "But you have nothing to fear from us." She intones a low chant in Malay.

name: Buried Miner
text: Buried Miner gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action] Take 1-3 horror: Parley. Test [combat] (6). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each horror you took as part of this action's cost. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When Buried Miner would be defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: A Lost Memento
text:
If an investigator has "found a cheap memento," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
"These are the spirits of fallen miners," says Melati, holding onto the flimsy tin figurine you found. "This belonged to one of them. It is sculpted from tin from this very mine. Tzu San Niang's heartless business separated the workers from their families. And now, they will never be reunited, except in death." She holds the tin figurine over the surface of the water and lets go of it. You think you can see the outline of wispy, spectral hands grasping at it as it sinks to the bottom of the pit.
Add this card to the victory display.
flavor: Warm, heavy rain begins to fall as you traverse the treacherous walkways. The moans of the departed echo in the dim. Melati holds one hand to her forehead and puts the other to the chiseled rock.

name: Buried Miner
text: Buried Miner gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action] Take 1-3 horror: Parley. Test [combat] (6). Reduce the difficulty of this test by 1 for each horror you took as part of this action's cost. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When Buried Miner would be defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Exhume the Bones
text:
If an investigator has "found hidden bones," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
"These are the spirits of fallen miners," says Melati, gesturing to the oily dark water. "Compelled by Tzu San Niang's relentless greed, the foreman of the mine has worked them... well, literally to the bone. Their bodies lie, unburied, in these deep pits." With her help, you begin exhuming the bones of the fallen miners. It is gruesome, awful work, but as you do it, you can feel a sense of gratitude wash over you. Only when you are finished can you feel a final wave of relief emanate from your surroundings.
Add this card to the victory display.
flavor: The mines are pocked with deep pits brimming with dark, black rainwater. As you traverse the treacherous paths, spectral hands dart out of the water, grasping at you. Melati holds up one hand and turns her ear, as if listening for a whisper.

name: Slain Foreman
text: Slain Foreman gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action] Discard an asset you control: Parley. Test [intellect] (6). Reduce the difficulty of this test by the printed cost of the asset discarded as part of this action's cost. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When Slain Foreman would be defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Sympathy Pain
text:
If an investigator has "shared a deep pain," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
Melati prepares a ritual of banishment as you stare into the spirit's eyes. While the bomoh chants, you feel a ripple of pain resonate in your own mind, and for a moment you glimpse a memory from the rail worker's life: them, holding a sledgehammer, as a shadowy figure stood above them, smiling cruelly. A sudden blur of motion, followed by an awful screech. As the memory fades, so too does the spirit.
Add this card to the victory display.
flavor: A pained howl echoes through the station as the shade bears down on you, bleeding ethereal blood and clutching its side. Melati holds up one hand to stop you. "This spirit is in great distress for a loss," she says. "It will only respond to one who has shared in its anguish."

name: Slain Foreman
text: Slain Foreman gets +1 [per_investigator] health. [action] Discard an asset you control: Parley. Test [intellect] (6). Reduce the difficulty of this test by the printed cost of the asset discarded as part of this action's cost. If you succeed, flip this card and resolve the text on its other side. Forced - When Slain Foreman would be defeated: Flip it over and resolve the text on its other side.

name: Familial Pain
text:
If an investigator has "traded for a kitten," read the following (otherwise, flip this card back to its enemy side, heal all damage from it, disengage it from all investigators, and exhaust it):
Melati gestures for you to hold the kitten out to the spirit. "This one had two daughters and many cats," the bomoh says. "They simply want to know their loved ones are cared for." The spirit reaches out and strokes the kitten's fur with a glimmering, spectral hand. After speaking rapidly in Malay, Melati looks to you. "Bringing this animal to the family of the departed would comfort them. I have told the spirit I will bring it as a gift soon." When you look, the spirit has vanished.
Add this card to the victory display.
flavor: As Melati entreats the spirit, it turns its head, as if it hears something you can't. The bomoh pulls you aside, a gentle smile upon her face. "It's searching for something," she explains. "Something that reminds it of home."

name: Excruciate
text: Revelation - Place 1 charge on The Shade Reaper. Test [willpower] (3) (6 instead if there are 8 or more charges on The Shade Reaper). If you fail, you must either discard 1 card from your hand for each point you fail by, or take 2 damage.
flavor: "Your pain feeds me."

name: Spirit Harvest
text: Peril. Revelation - Either (choose one): - Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror. - Tzu San Niang shifts The Shade Reaper and then places 2 charges on it.

name: Tzu San Niang
text: Concealed 2. Forced - When Tzu San Niang would be defeated: Instead, heal all damage from her, remove all doom from play, return her to the shadows, and resolve her concealed keyword, distributing each of those concealed mini-cards as evenly as possible among each location with a non-weakness [[Geist]] enemy.
subname: The Lady with the Red Parasol

name: Tzu San Niang
text: Hunter. Retaliate. Tzu San Niang gets +2 [per_investigator] health. Forced - When you succeed at a skill test while attempting to fight or evade Tzu San Niang: Remove 1 charge from The Shade Reaper for each point you succeeded by. Take damage and/or horror equal to the number of charges removed, divided as equally as possible.

name: The Shade Reaper
text: Shift - Choose a non-[[Elite]] enemy at your location. You may move that enemy to a connecting location. You may force that enemy to attack another enemy at its location, dealing its horror as damage. Flip this key to its [[Unstable]] side.
flavor: File #46-Q27 / Subject Class: Red / Key unknown

name: The Shade Reaper
text: Shift - Each investigator loses 1 action (or if it is not their turn, loses 1 action during their next turn). Then, if an investigator shifted this key, flip it to its [[Stable]] side.
flavor: ...capable of metaphysical absorption? / release conforms to indicated patterns of neural suppression...

name: Without a Trace
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is half the number of locations in play, rounded down.
[cultist]: -4. If you fail, the nearest [[Outsider]] enemy readies, moves once toward you, and attacks you if it is at your location.
[tablet]: -X. X is the number of set-aside hollows you own (max 5).
[elder_thing]: -3. If you fail, choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, as a hollow.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is the number of locations in play.
[cultist]: -6. If you fail, the nearest [[Outsider]] enemy readies, moves once toward you, and attacks you if it is at your location.
[tablet]: -X. X is 1 plus the number of set-aside hollows you own.
[elder_thing]: -3. Choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, as a hollow.

name: Otherworldly Horror
text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location).
backText:
Shuffle the set-aside Apocalyptic Presage and Protoplasmic Reassembler enemies into the encounter deck.
The investigators must choose two options, as a group:
- Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror.
- Each investigator chooses a non-weakness card they control in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
- Shuffle all concealed mini-cards facedown, then place them at random in the positions they were in.
flavor: Beyond our reality, in the dimension known only to the forgotten and the forsaken, lies the preposterous City of Remnants - the home world of the Outsiders themselves.

name: Otherworldly Lambs
text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location).
backText:
The investigators must choose two options, as a group:
- Each investigator takes 1 damage and 1 horror.
- Each investigator chooses a non-weakness card they control in their hand or play area and sets it aside, out of play, as a hollow.
- Shuffle all concealed mini-cards facedown, then place them at random in the positions they were in.
flavor: The longer you stay in this realm, the more your grip on the world you came from begins to slip. Faces, names, and places all fall through the gaps in your memory. You realize with horror that the power of the Outside goes both ways. Simply being in this realm, even of your own volition, is enough to lose yourself.

name: Otherworldly Slaughter
text: As an additional cost to enter an unrevealed location, investigators at your location must spend 1[per_investigator] clues, as a group. [reaction] After you expose a location: Move to that location (from an adjacent location). [fast] Take 1 direct damage or 1 direct horror: Look at the revealed side of a concealed mini-card (without exposing it). (Group limit once per round.)
backText:
Each investigator who has not resigned is driven insane, and is never seen or heard from again. All memory of their existence is purged from reality.
If any investigators resigned, those investigators may immediately advance to act 3b.
flavor: come you did what do to here ?again

name: Traversing the Outside
text: Objective - Find the heart of the Outsiders' domain. When the Outsiders' Lair is revealed, advance.
backText: Spawn the set-aside Mimetic Nemesis enemy at Outsiders' Lair, exhausted. Each investigator chooses 2 non-weakness cards in their discard pile and sets them aside, out of play, as hollows. Find the set-aside The Red-Gloved Man story asset and place him with the other set-aside hollows, as a hollow. He is considered to be owned by all of the investigators. If he is the bearer of any keys, do not attach those keys to him.
flavor: Somewhere in this strange otherworld lies a secret so vital, an ages-old member of the Red Coterie was willing to reach out to you personally to have you help her find this place - the world where all things stolen from memory end up. If the truth is anywhere, it must be here.

name: Red Ruin
text: The Red-Gloved Man cannot be discarded or drawn. [action] If Mimetic Nemesis is at your location, spend 1 clue: Deal 2 damage to it. This action does not provoke attacks of opportunity from Mimetic Nemesis. Objective - When The Red-Gloved man enters play, advance.
flavor: You don't truly know what's going on, but you know it can't be good. You have to stop whatever process is happening here - only then can you learn the truth from the man in the red gloves.

name: Escaping the Otherworld
text: Each [[Outsider]] enemy loses aloof. Forced - If The Red-Gloved Man is defeated: Remove him from the game. Objective - Time to get the hell out of here! If each surviving investigator has resigned, advance.
backText: Check which [[Conspirator]] assets are in the victory display. - If both The Red-Gloved Man and Aliki Zoni Uperetria are in the victory display, proceed to (→R1) (page 57). - If The Red-Gloved Man is in the victory display, proceed to (→R2) (page 58). - If Aliki Zoni Uperetria is in the victory display, proceed to (→R3) (page 58). - If neither The Red-Gloved Man nor Aliki Zoni Uperetria are in the victory display, proceed to (→R4) (page 58).
flavor: The Red-Gloved Man is on your side and answers are finally within reach. But first you must find a way back home... because if you can't, this might become your new home.

name: Court of the Outsiders
text: [action]: Resign. Test [willpower] or [agility] (4). If you succeed, you resign, adding each [[Conspirator]] asset you control to the victory display. If you fail, you remain trapped here, and this test gets -1 difficulty until the end of your turn. If each surviving investigator has resigned, immediately advance to act 3b.

name: Outsiders' Lair
text:
Each [[Outsider]] enemy at this location loses aloof and gets +1 fight and +1 evade.
[fast] If The Red-Gloved Man is the only set-aside hollow: Put him into play under the control of any investigator at Outsiders' Lair.
backText: Concealed 1. Forced - When you expose this location: - If it is in the left position in the shadows, take 1 damage. - If it is in the middle position in the shadows, choose a non-weakness card in your hand and set it aside, out of play, as a hollow. - If it is on the right position in the shadows, take 1 horror.

name: Mimetic Nemesis
text: Alert. Hunter. Massive. Retaliate. Forced - When you would deal damage to this enemy: Instead, choose and discard that many set-aside hollows. Forced - At the end of the round: Each investigator at this enemy's location must either choose a non-weakness card in their hand and set it aside, as a hollow, or this enemy attacks them.

name: Protoplasmic Reassembler
text: Massive. Spawn - Location farthest from all investigators. Forced - At the end of the enemy phase, if this enemy is ready: Spawn the top card of the nearest investigator's deck facedown at its location as a Golem enemy. Golems have: "[[Monster. Outsider.]] Hunter. 1 fight, 1 health, 1 evade, 1 damage value. If Golem is defeated, set it aside, out of play, as a hollow."

name: The Red-Gloved Man
text: [reaction] After you successfully fight or evade an [[Outsider]] enemy by 2 or more, exhaust The Red-Gloved Man: Deal 1 damage to that enemy and discover 1 clue at your location.
flavor: "The final shift - has it told you what it means?"

name: Aliki Zoni Uperetria
text: [reaction] After a concealed mini-card is exposed, exhaust Aliki Zoni Uperetria: Choose a set-aside hollow. Its owner draws it.
subname: The Maid with the Scarlet Sash

name: Congress of the Keys
text:
Easy / Standard
[skull]: -X. X is the current act number.
[cultist]: -5. You may flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side to treat this token's modifier as -2, instead.
[tablet]: -2. If this is an attack against a ready [[Outsider]] enemy, you automatically fail, instead.
[elder_thing]: -3. Cancel the effects and icons of each card committed to this test and set each of them aside, out of play, as hollows.
backText:
Hard / Expert
[skull]: -X. X is 1 more than the current act number.
[cultist]: -7. You may flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side to treat this token's modifier as -4, instead.
[tablet]: -2. If there is a ready [[Outsider]] enemy at your location, you automatically fail, instead.
[elder_thing]: -4. Cancel the effects and icons of each card committed to this test and set each of them aside, out of play, as hollows.

name: Conflux of Consequence
text: Forced - When this agenda advances, if it is act 2, 3, or 4: Skip the "b" side of this agenda and proceed directly to agenda 2a.
backText:
If the current act is Secrets and Lies (v. I):
Leylines of paradimensional energy surround you, threatening to tear you apart.
Each enemy shifts each of their attached keys. Immediately resolve an additional enemy phase (then resume the current phase).
If the current act is Secrets and Lies (v. II):
The portal the red-gloved man opened is almost shut! With no time left to prepare, you leap inside just before it closes.
Place 4 doom on agenda 2a. Advance the act.
If the current act is Secrets and Lies (v. III):
Extradimensional entities surround you, threatening to erase your very existence.
Flip 1 [per_investigator] keys from their [[Stable]] side to their [[Unstable]] side. Immediately resolve an additional enemy phase (then resume with the current phase).
flavor: You have come here to find us, but we found you long, long ago. You will be just another set piece in the monument that is our ultimate prayer to the Elder Ones. See our Grand Temple and hear our Call, O Great Ones beyond the beyond!

name: The World Unbidden
backText:
Flip each decoy over. Shuffle all concealed mini-cards in play, then place them at random in the positions they were in.
Each investigator takes 2 damage and 2 horror but may either (choose one, or neither):
- Shift an [[Unstable]] key they control without flipping it to its [[Stable]] side to cancel all of the damage and horror just dealt to them by the above effect.
- Flip any number of [[Stable]] keys they control to their [[Unstable]] side to cancel that much damage/horror just dealt to them by the above effect.
flavor: So you deign to scale our monument? Our relic to the many worlds we have devoured? Oh yes; yours is not the first. Very well then. Climb to the vertex, if you can, and behold your ruin.

name: Running Red
backText: Each investigator is defeated.
flavor: Hark! You approach your own ruin. Its scarlet robes are the skin of foes long since vanquished. Its embroidery woven with the arteries of Kings long devoured. Its crown forged from the obelisks of once-great civilizations. You are just another meal. You, too, will be forgotten. And in the end only we shall reign.

name: Secrets and Lies (v. I)
text: The Red-Gloved Man gains concealed 1 [per_investigator] and cannot be damaged. Objective - At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same location as The Red-Gloved Man, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
backText: Remove each location from the game. (Investigators are not defeated during this process. Other enemies and attachments at those locations are discarded, and concealed mini-cards are set aside.) Put The Knotted Tower, Gravity-Defying Climb, and The Towering Vertex locations into play in a straight vertical line, with The Towering Vertex at the top and The Knotted Tower at the bottom. Take the top 3 locations in the Otherworld deck and place them in the shadows, arranged in a line from left to right. Take the 3 City of Remnants mini-cards, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around The Knotted Tower as follows: One to its left, one to its right, and one below. Place each investigator at The Knotted Tower and The Red-Gloved Man enemy at the Towering Vertex. Remove the encounter deck and encounter discard pile from the game, replacing them with the second encounter deck.
flavor: You have to find the man with the red gloves and discover what his plan is, but the remainder of the Red Coterie stands in your way. Don't they realize the true threat here?

name: Secrets and Lies (v. II)
text: Do not draw cards from the encounter deck during the mythos phase. Objective - Prepare for your journey into the Outside, and proceed when you are ready. At the end of any round, if each investigator is at the same location, they may advance. The sooner, the better. (Hint - You will also be forced to advance automatically when the agenda advances.)
backText: Remove agenda 1a from the game, moving all of its doom to agenda 2a. Remove each location from the game. (Investigators are not defeated during this process. Other enemies and attachments at those locations are discarded, and concealed mini-cards are set aside.) Put The Knotted Tower, Gravity-Defying Climb, and The Towering Vertex locations into play in a straight vertical line, with The Towering Vertex at the top and The Knotted Tower at the bottom. Take the top 3 locations in the Otherworld deck and place them in the shadows, arranged in a line from left to right. Take the 3 City of Remnants mini-cards and X decoys, where X is the amount of doom on agenda 2a, shuffle them facedown, and distribute them as evenly as possible around The Knotted Tower to its left, right, and below. Place each investigator at The Knotted Tower and The Red-Gloved Man enemy at the Towering Vertex. Shuffle each other set-aside [[Coterie]] enemy into the encounter deck. (Note: From now on, draw cards from the encounter deck during each mythos phase, as normal.)
flavor: You have one last chance to explore the Red Coterie's hideout before you depart. But time is of the essence!

name: Secrets and Lies (v. III)
text: The Red-Gloved Man gains concealed 1 [per_investigator] and cannot be damaged. Objective - At the end of the round, if each investigator is at the same location as The Red-Gloved Man, they may spend the requisite number of clues, as a group, to advance.
backText: Remove each location from the game. (Investigators are not defeated during this process. Other enemies and attachments at those locations are discarded, and concealed mini-cards are set aside.) Put The Knotted Tower, Gravity-Defying Climb, and The Towering Vertex locations into play in a straight vertical line, with The Towering Vertex at the top and The Knotted Tower at the bottom. Take the top 3 locations in the Otherworld deck and place them in the shadows, arranged in a line from left to right. Take the 3 City of Remnants mini-cards, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around The Knotted Tower as follows: One to its left, one to its right, and one below. Place each investigator at The Knotted Tower and The Red-Gloved Man enemy at the Towering Vertex.
flavor: Outsiders have attacked the Red Coterie's hideout! Only one among them has the answers you seek. You must find the "Red-Gloved Man" - or the entity that wears his face - and follow it back to the world whence it came.

name: To the Tower
text: Locations and concealed mini-cards cannot be placed adjacent to [[Tower]] locations. Objective - Find a way into the tower where the infiltrator lies in wait. If an investigator enters the Gravity-Defying Climb, advance.
backText:
Set each concealed mini-card aside, out of play. Remove each City of Remnants in the shadows and the remainder of the Otherworld deck from the game.
Take the 3 City of Remnants concealed mini-cards and 1 [per_investigator] decoys, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around Gravity-Defying Climb in a random order.
flavor: Beyond all of known reality, in the dimension known only to the forgotten and the forsaken, lies the preposterous City of Remnants - the home world of the Outsiders themselves. Looming before you, a terrifying, twisted tower of jumbled architecture is a nexus of roiling mist and clouds across an alien sky.

name: The Ascent
text: Objective - Ascend. If an investigator enters The Towering Vertex, advance.
backText:
Set each concealed mini-card aside, out of play.
Swap the set-aside Mimetic Nemesis enemy with The Red-Gloved Man enemy at The Towering Vertex.
Take the Mimetic Nemesis's mini-card and 2 [per_investigator] decoys, shuffle them facedown, and arrange them around The Towering Vertex in a random order.
flavor:
A terrible feeling of vertigo washes over you as you begin to scale the cyclopean, Escheresque steps.
Only one way to go now.

name: The Final Err
text: [action] Flip a [[Stable]] key you control to its [[Unstable]] side: Remove an exposed decoy from the game. Objective - If Mimetic Nemesis is defeated, advance.
flavor: You brandish the keys you have collected and brace yourself. If you cannot expel this entity and collapse this dimension, it will be the end of you all - and none will ever be the wiser. This is it. Your last chance before there is nothing of you left. nothing of you left nothing

name: Scarlet Halls
text: [fast] Exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset you control: Move (to a connecting location).
flavor: Perhaps if you had a guide, these labyrinthine halls would not be so perplexing.

name: Scarlet Halls
text: Forced - After you enter Scarlet Halls: For the remainder of your turn, as an additional cost for you to move from Scarlet Halls to a connecting location, you must either exhaust a [[Conspirator]] asset you control or spend an additional action.

name: Congress Chamber
